name: Debug Menu
author: Moon Sweepers Mods
description:
Testing tools. In-game, open the pause menu (Esc) and a DEBUG panel appears on the right (F7 hides or shows it).

Unlimited money, +$10,000, unlimited suit energy, fly mode, empty or fill your vehicle's hopper, and spawn any vehicle in front of you, including vehicles added by other mods.

Meant for testing: it changes your save (money, vehicles). Host only: in someone else's crew it turns itself off, since the host controls money, time and vehicles.
